title: Inside Tessl's Software Factory — NYC & Boston, Sept 16-17
description:
We've built a software factory at Tessl, and it looks nothing like the diagram. On September 16 and 17, engineer Sahil Deshmukh is in New York and Boston with a practical walkthrough of how it actually works — the components, the decisions, and which metrics were worth tracking.

What we cover:
– How we built our software factory at Tessl, component by component
– Why each piece is there and what it's actually for
– The metrics we focused on early that didn't help, and the ones that did
– What engineering looks like in an AI native world
– The quirks and features that shaped the factory we run today

Build your software factory, one workflow at a time, with Tessl:
https://tessl.co/kqj

🔔 Subscribe for weekly videos on AI-native development

If you're building a software factory of your own, tell us what you're measuring — we'd like to compare notes.
